text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder and I are returning<n>from a photo
shoot she had in her<n>signature racewear. We're
walking<n>down the hallway when I realize<n>something.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer? Is something the matter?
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking, the crest on your top matches
the badge you wear on your ear.

I was just thinking, the crest on your top matches
the badge you wear on your ear.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you have a good eye for<n>details. Yes, it's the
same symbol.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Did you know? It looks like a "G" if<n>you look at it
from the side.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Sei? How long have you<n>been listening?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, does that mean I got it right?<n>Been curious for
a while, actually.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Is the G supposed to be your initial?<n>Or does it
stand for something else,<n>like "Grace"?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now, isn't that a good question.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seiun keeps pressing for an answer,<n>but Grass
Wonder evades the<n>question every time.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I wake up the next morning still<n>curious about the
design. Later, as I<n>wait for Grass Wonder for
training...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. Hehe, why do<n>you look so
perplexed?
choice_data_list: I'm still trying to work out what the "G" stands for...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I should've told you<n>yesterday, but I
was a bit too<n>embarrassed to answer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's just what Sei said—the "G"<n>stands for both my
name and<n>"Grace."

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's a lot more to Grass Wonder<n>than just
being graceful and polite.<n>Perhaps that's why her
explanation<n>doesn't sit quite right with me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But?
choice_data_list: There has to be more to it than that.
There has to be more to it than that.
It could mean "Green Tea" too, couldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But?
choice_data_list: There has to be more to it than that.
There has to be more to it than that.
It could mean "Green Tea" too, couldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well... Um.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. As a matter of fact, there is.<n>You're quite
astute.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... I'm a little flattered<n>that you noticed.
Not many people do,<n>you know.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but that's all I'll say for now.<n>It's about time
we started training.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She gracefully steps out onto the<n>track, but then
suddenly turns to face<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I can tell you one last thing.<n>I like to
always carry a reminder of<n>what's important to me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And as you know, my ambitions are<n>not easily
satisfied. So I hope you will<n>aid me in achieving...
the goals I seek.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The following week, she claims an<n>impressive
victory in a race. Seeing<n>the strength of her desire
to win, I'm<n>filled with a renewed determination to
support her no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Well... It definitely does now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The symbol represents what's<n>important to me,
and green tea<n>certainly fits the bill.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still... it makes me happy that you've<n>put so much
thought into such a tiny<n>aspect of my racewear.
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So I suppose... I'll let you in on my<n>secret. This
stays between us,<n>understood?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She smiles, leans in close, and<n>whispers a single
word.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The following week, Grass Wonder<n>claims an
impressive victory during a<n>race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Struck by her determination to<n>succeed, I quietly
renew my own<n>resolve to support her until the day
she achieves... the glory she<n>deserves.
